title: Mobile & Responsive Access
observations: Concept phase caught critical product stance change: 9 doc locations saying 'desktop-only' contradicted the v1 mobile work. Forced doc updates into the workpackage scope. Cost signal: 30m concept work saved 2h post-ship confusion.

Architecture plan reconciliation table (8 assumptions verified with line numbers) prevented 3+ bugs: conversationsBlockingCount derivation, --surface-overlay token mismatch, sidebar width call-site enumeration. Pattern reuse: same structure validated across AA1, AB3, AD3, AD5.

Phase 2 critiques (design + architecture): 1 CRITICAL (focus trap ambiguity) + 15 WARNINGs. Code review verified 16/16 items resolved (100% resolution rate). Builder did not rationalize away findings.

TDD red phase (28 tests) caught cosmetic gap early: drawer animation never fires due to conditional rendering (CSS transition has no prior state to animate from). Flagged as D-1 suggestion in code review, deferred to visual-polish.

Deferred items tracked but not owned: drawer animation, Android back button popstate handler, per-page responsive adjustments (Task 4). Pattern: 'known gaps for v1' need explicit ownership assignment or drift unowned into next pipeline iteration.

AppShell crossed extraction threshold (777 lines, planned max 600) without extraction. Mobile branch is ~155 LOC of new code. Threshold enforcement via linting/build config would prevent gradual degradation better than post-hoc review notes.

CORS lazy parsing: moved parseConfiguredOrigins() from module load to per-request inside resolveOrigin(), enabling vi.stubEnv() tests to work without special re-import logic. @lore comment explains the decision.

Sidebar width migration: w-[200px] fixed → w-full + parent container controls width. Zero prop API change, clean preservation of component stability across desktop (200px) and drawer (280px) contexts. 8 call sites enumerated and updated.

All 6 ACs delivered. Protected tests (U6-viewport-breakpoint, U6-AppShell-sidebar, cors.integration) pass unmodified. Typecheck clean, lint clean, no any/as casts. 19 source files changed, 28 tests written.

Critique enforcement: all 16 items resolved, 100% handoff quality
Red phase (tests): 90m covering 28 tests, caught animation gap early
Green phase (code): 120m for 200 net new lines, efficient conditional branching
Code review: 60m including 6 lenses, AC completeness audit, 4 suggestions
patterns: Design critiques → 90%+ resolution rate (AE4 = 16/16). Critique process is working; standardize Phase 2 Critique Resolution Audit table format.
Reconciliation tables prevent silent bugs (verified across AA1, AB3, AD3, AD5, AE4). Make them required artifact in /architecture output.
'Known gaps' need explicit ownership or they drift unowned. Retro log should flag deferred items → [next-workpackage-id].
Extraction thresholds should be enforced by linting/build, not reviewed post-hoc. AppShell 777 lines is 27% over threshold.
Test-first cosmetic gap detection works: drawer animation issue caught in red phase, preventing post-ship surprise. Acceptable if explicitly deferred.
